workItems.objective: Replace memclaw_session_start's raw-weight top-5 with a recency/usage-blended re-rank done in core-api (fetch a wider weight-sorted window from storage, re-rank in Python — no new SQL), exclude memory_type='rule' rows from the memories section, and apply the RE-03 compact projection plus a fixed ~300-char content cap to the session_start payload.
acceptanceCriteria: memclaw_session_start (mcp_server.py:3891-3939) raises its storage fetch from limit 5 to limit 25 (same single list_memories_by_filters call at :3920-3921, sort=weight desc unchanged — no new storage endpoint, no SQL in core-api) and re-ranks in Python: score = weight * recency_decay(created_at) * (1 + log1p(recall_count)), taking the top 5. The (1 + ...) term is load-bearing: never-recalled memories must not be zeroed out. ASSUMPTION to flag in the commit body: exact decay half-life (propose ~30 days) is an implementation choice, not user-specified — flip on Leon's word

Rows with memory_type='rule' are excluded from the memories section (keystones are already returned separately in the same payload — mcp_server.py:3922; a rule-typed memory in the memories list is exactly the 'Fake rule generated for testing' artifact class the plan doc measured).
